company_summary: ElevenLabs is a startup that utilizes AI technology to develop voice AI research and products. The company's core product involves AI models and frameworks to achieve this goal, although specific details about the models and frameworks are not provided. Recently, ElevenLabs has secured a Series B investment, indicating a significant funding stage, which will help the company solidify its position as a global leader in voice AI. The team size is not mentioned, but the company has a role called Forward Deployed Engineers who work closely with clients to deploy production-ready AI solutions.
